info.title: Open Managed Agents API
info.description: HTTP API for managing Agents, managed MCP servers, Loops, Skills, Workspaces, Sessions, Events, API keys, and Workspace files.

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description: User registration and Tenant session tokens.

tags.name: MCP Catalog
tags.description: Host-reviewed MCP servers that can be safely equipped on Agents.

tags.name: API Keys
tags.description: Tenant API credentials and their token usage.

tags.name: Sessions/Usage

tags.description: Durable user input and Complete Events, with optional live Deltas.

tags.name: Sessions/Workspace Files
tags.description: File operations within a Session's Workspace.
